summary: Practise IPSAS transition, accrual schedules and public-sector reporting with government and donor-funded cases. Explore the course outline.
lede: IPSAS implementation training helps public-sector accountants and finance teams convert accounting records into accrual-based financial statements. Participants practise preparing opening-balance schedules, assessing assets and liabilities, classifying revenue, and making consolidation adjustments; they also work on budget reconciliations and disclosures using government and donor-funded programme scenarios.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or support IPSAS-based accounts in government, public agencies and donor-funded programmes. It suits practitioners with accounting or public-finance responsibilities who need to work with accrual records, reporting schedules and financial statements.
prerequisites: Prior experience in public-sector, NGO, audit or programme accounting is recommended. You should be familiar with basic financial statements and ledger records. Coding or programming is not required.
